title: Waste and scrap of precious metal (except gold) or of metal clad with precious metal (except gold)

review.classification: CPC June 2025 PDF p.203 and October 2026 workbook row 1915 distinguish the retained non-gold precious scrap from gold (39331) and ash (39333). WCO HS 2022 chapter 71 distinguishes 7112.99 from platinum, gold, ash and electrical waste and scrap in 8549. A useable sheet remnant held for further cutting is outside the recovery-feed reference.
review.primary_evidence: Morris & Watson lists sterling as a plate option, the STG-925 grade separately from other sterling alloys, and actual guillotine cutting of sheet. The refinery expressly lists eligible identifiable clean plate offcuts originating from its own supply. The July 2023 New Zealand refining terms distinguish conditional reception, origin disclosure, assay or settlement, and specific fees. These documents support a product-specific source chain, without establishing a matched manufacturer/customer lot. The historical Taylor blanking report describes punching and does not establish guillotine shearing.
review.measurement: Q is net whole first-accepted solid offcut mass, tare and foreign matter excluded; retained silver mass, refinery payable content and refined output are separate bases. Anchor joint sheet/blank/offcut burdens at the actual cold-cutting gate, carry exchange-specific WIP vectors, retain failed production loads, and allocate post-release service to its original cohort. Purchase, first external receipt, traceable return of the same issued container, dispatch, outward return and retirement require disjoint records.
review.native_records: The broad public scrap Product datasets do not establish an uncoated single-source, cold-sheared saleable Ag-Cu offcut. Verified silver and copper are species-specific elementary emissions to unspecified air; measuring a whole offcut, a removed metal piece, retained metal or collected dust cannot support such an emission by itself. Mass/kg and Energy to the units-of-energy group are independently archive-checked. The electrical service provider remains unbound.
review.readiness: English and Chinese each contain 19 exchange cards. Seventeen identities remain unbound, including the reference Product. Scoped target check 98 performed, zero skipped and 15 missing-range warnings. Specific sheet grade and non-gold alloy assay, ownership, lot transfer basis, plant and external work, measured utilities/emissions and compatible providers remain study obligations. Candidate/authored methodology, Chinese aligned; expert science and formal translation review pending.
